name: XRISM
summary: Joint JAXA–NASA high-resolution X-ray mission whose Resolve spectroscopy can test unidentified narrow lines, including sterile-neutrino decay.
detection_principle: The cryogenic Resolve microcalorimeter measures photon energies, while Xtend provides wide-field imaging. Stacked galaxy-cluster spectra search for anomalous lines against instrumental / atomic backgrounds.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: NASA lists the mission as active, and galaxy-cluster spectral analyses have been published.

results.summary: Upper limits on unidentified lines, including at 3.5 keV. Sensitivity differs from historical XMM samples, so no blanket exclusion follows directly.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
